preview.topic: Follow up on an unpaid invoice, third reminder
preview.subject: Subject: Invoice #2481 — still outstanding
preview.body:
Hi Martin,

Invoice #2481 was due on 12 May and is still unpaid. This is my third reminder.

Please settle it by Friday, or let me know the date I can expect the payment.

Best,
Anna

features.title: What it actually does
features.subtitle: Four fields, one button. The rest is our job.

tone.title: Tone you can hear
tone.text: Formal, Friendly, Persuasive, Direct. The difference shows up in the first sentence, not in a label.

length.title: Length that means something
length.text: Short is one paragraph. Long is five. You pick what the situation deserves.

speed.title: Seconds, not minutes
speed.text: The blank page is the expensive part. We hand you a full draft to react to instead.

history.title: Everything is kept
history.text: Every email you generate stays in your history. Reopen it, copy it, send it again.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.text: English, Ukrainian and Russian — interface and emails alike. Switch anytime.

privacy.title: Your drafts are yours
privacy.text: Emails are stored under your account only. No sharing, no training on your text.

one.title: Say what it is about
one.text: One line is enough: “ask the landlord to fix the heating, second time”.

two.title: Choose tone and length
two.text: Same topic, four tones, three lengths. Twelve ways to say the same thing.

three.title: Copy and send
three.text: Subject and body come out together. Edit if you want, or send as it is.

q1.a: Yes. The free plan gives you 5 emails a day, forever, without a card. Premium removes the limit.

q2.a: This build ships with a deterministic local generator, so the app runs with no API key at all. The generation layer sits behind one interface, so a hosted model can be plugged in by changing a single line.

q3.q: Will it sound like a robot?
q3.a: It sounds like the tone you picked. Direct is blunt, Friendly uses first names, Formal keeps its distance. If it is not right, regenerate — it costs one of your daily five.

q4.a: Of course. The output is plain text in a field you can type into. Most people change one sentence and send.

q5.a: No. They are stored in your account so you can find them later, and nowhere else.

q6.q: What happens if I hit the daily limit?
q6.a: You see how long is left until the counter resets, and a link to Pricing. Nothing you already generated is lost.
